test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The monthly income of Reena was ₹75,200 and her monthly expenditure was ₹22,500. Next year, her income increased by 25% and her expenditure by 14%. Find the percentage increase in her savings (rounded off to 2 decimal places).
solution:
**Given:**

Monthly income of Reena = ₹75,200

Monthly expenditure of Reena = ₹22,500

Income increase = 25%

Expenditure increase = 14%

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income - Expenditure

Percentage Increase in Savings = dfrac{New Savings - Old Savings}{Old Savings} times 100

**Calculations:**

Old Savings = ₹75,200 - ₹22,500

⇒ Old Savings = ₹52,700

New Income = ₹75,200 × 1.25

⇒ New Income = ₹94,000

New Expenditure = ₹22,500 × 1.14

⇒ New Expenditure = ₹25,650

New Savings = ₹94,000 - ₹25,650

⇒ New Savings = ₹68,350

Percentage Increase in Savings = dfrac{₹68,350 - ₹52,700}{₹52,700} times 100

⇒ Percentage Increase in Savings = dfrac{₹15,650}{₹52,700} times 100

⇒ Percentage Increase in Savings ≈ 29.70%

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
